And the pulmonary artery was divided to the right and left branches directly after the fenestration. LV, left ventricle; LVO, left ventricular outflow tract; RV, right ventricle; RVO, right ventricular outflow tract; AV, aortic valve; PV, pulmonary valve. Star, aortopulmonary fenestration.
